description: Carbamazepin und Koffein - Potenzielle Screeningparameter für Verunreinigungen des Grundwassers durch kommunales Abwasser? is a dataset listed in opendataportal.at, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by umweltbundesamt.at. As part of the pilot project ‘Carbamazepine and caffeine – potential screening parameters for municipal groundwater contamination?’, 56 groundwater monitoring stations sampled under the Water Quality Survey Ordinance (WGEV) were examined for the substances carbamazepine and caffeine. Coverage: AT. The portal shows the English title as "Carbamazepine and caffeine - Potential screening parameters for groundwater contamination by urban wastewater?" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Abfallwirtschaft, OpenDocument, Wasser. The listing shows 1 download or service links in PDF. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.de). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-portal-austria.
